*block_header

1   timestamp                           4 bajta uint32 
2   master  name                        8 bajta uint64
3   confirmed                           2 bajta uint16
4   previous                            32 bajta checksum256
5   transaction_mroot                   32 bajta checksum256
6   action_mroot                        32 bajta checksum256
7   schedule_version                    4 bajta uint32
8   new_masters master_schedule?        Varijabilno Opcionalno, prisustvo zavisi od podataka, min 0 B
9   header_extensions   extension[]     Varijabilno Niz proširenja, može biti prazan, min 1 bajt (broj elemenata)

* signed_block_header

10 master_signature                     65 bajta K1 signature

*signed_block_v0

11  transactions: transaction_receipt_v0[]  min 1bajt
12  block_extensions : extension[]          min 1bajt
